Method of Attack: Malicious code embedded in seccache's cache_manager.py triggers a reverse shell connecting to 4.tcp.ngrok.io
Combination attack using seccache as dependency and trigger packages that import cache_manager to activate reverse shell
Use of dependency relationship to hide malicious code and trigger execution via separate packages
Discoverer: 天问Python供应链威胁监测模块
Impacted Systems: Python environments where these packages are installed
Attack Vector: Installation of trigger packages that declare dependency on seccache, causing automatic installation and execution of malicious code
Importing cache_manager from seccache in trigger packages' __init__.py to activate reverse shell
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious package seccache with empty __init__.py and malicious cache_manager.py
Trigger packages: sea-django-mysqlpool, prometheus-http-client-shopee, splib-http, shpee-dynamic-cache, python-splib, kazoo-shopee
